prompts.walk: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: production animation sprite sheet, no text. Use the reference ONLY as the exact identity/style source of the SINGLE blue-armband rifleman in top-left cell. Create ONE full seamless WALK/JOG cycle, exactly 12 frames in reading order, 4 columns by 3 rows, on transparent background. Output landscape 1536x1024 or larger same ratio. Strict equal cells, no borders, no labels. Every cell depicts ONE and the SAME soldier in SAME southeast-facing three-quarter orthographic 30-degree elevation camera, NOT different directions. Lock helmet, pouches, tactical vest, knee pads, olive uniform, black boots, blue armband, black rifle from reference. Identical figure height and ground pivot across frames, feet midpoint at x=50%, y=86% of EACH cell, helmet at y=18%; 15% safe horizontal margin. Cycle: left heel strike, left weight accept, left support/right passing, right knee lift, right swing, right heel nearing ground, right heel strike, right weight accept, right support/left passing, left knee lift, left swing, left heel nearing ground. Clear actual hip/knee/ankle articulation, two legs exchange roles; held rifle stabilized with both hands, torso small natural counter-motion. No sideways sliding or rotating, no camera motion, no extra people. Detailed hand-painted miniature RTS rendering, subdued worn olive cloth and metal, soft upper-left lighting, restrained realistic military proportions, match reference detail. Ground contact shadow subtle only, no floor or tile. This is sprite animation, not a comparison sheet of identical repeated still poses.
prompts.fire:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create transparent-background animation sprite sheet, 1536x1024, exactly 4 columns x 3 rows, 12 equal cells in reading order. Reference is identity/style guide: ONLY the single top-left blue-armband rifleman. Same detailed painted miniature game style, olive uniform, helmet, pouches, kneepads and black rifle. Camera identical fixed southeast-facing three-quarter orthographic 30-degree elevation. Soldier identical size and position in EVERY cell. Boots planted in a wide firing stance, midpoint x=43%,y=86% of each cell, helmet y=18%, muzzle points to lower-right along the 2:1 isometric ground direction. Fully transparent background, NO background gradients, NO floor, NO aura, NO shadows outside a tiny contact shadow. No labels or borders.
Animation: one aimed three-round BURST, then ready. 1 raise rifle from chest; 2 shoulder and aim; 3 first compact orange muzzle flash and tiny casing; 4 recoil shoulder slightly backward and smoke; 5 recovered aimed position; 6 second flash and case; 7 recoil; 8 recover; 9 third flash and case; 10 recoil and fine fading smoke; 11 settle; 12 shoulder-ready. Flash is very small and bright, not a flamethrower. Only arms, weapon, shoulders react. Maintain soldier identity, anatomy, camera, scale, armband and lighting across all 12 frames. Keep both boots planted at identical coordinates after frame 2. Leave 20% padding for rifle muzzle and effects. No sci-fi, blood, text or duplicate people.
prompts.build:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production RTS sprite animation sheet. Reference is exact design of BLUE vehicle factory in upper half. Generate its 12-stage CONSTRUCTION animation, exactly 4 columns x 3 rows of equally-sized cells, landscape 1536x1024. True transparent background outside objects, no backdrop/gradient/glow/vignette/grid/text/labels/borders. Same factory, same orthographic camera looking down 30 degrees, same 2:1 isometric diamond foundation, same fixed ground corners and scale in all twelve cells. Foundation width 78% each cell, center x=50%, lowest tip at y=88%; building roof final at y=30%. Blue-grey roof, warm grey concrete, yellow/black door hazard stripes, cream chevron, cyan small accents, upper-left soft light, painterly worn industrial miniatures, match reference. Never rotate/change scale.
Frames in reading order: 1 empty rectangular concrete foundation with anchor bolts and trenches; 2 steel column bases and material pallets; 3 half height structural columns; 4 full columns and cross braces, no walls; 5 completed steel skeleton and suspended roof beam; 6 rear walls fitted, roof rafters open; 7 side walls 70 percent and temporary scaffolding; 8 complete walls with exposed roof trusses; 9 half the navy roof panels installed, yellow small construction hoist visible; 10 roof completed, door frame and vents being fitted, scaffold partly removed; 11 almost finished, lights turning on, minimal scaffold; 12 EXACT completed reference factory including open factory door and interior workshop, no scaffold. Mechanical assembly of solid pieces, no magical holographic growth. Maintain precisely the same footprint, front-door location, architecture and roof pitch. No workers required. Plenty of separation between sprites, no objects cross cell boundaries.
prompts.ruin:
Use case: stylized-concept. RTS production animation sheet showing the destruction of the BLUE vehicle factory in reference upper half. 12 equally spaced frames arranged 4 columns x 3 rows in reading order, 1536x1024 landscape. Transparent background outside objects, no gradients, no scenery, no text, no labels, no borders. Fixed orthographic 30-degree elevation camera, identical scale, foundation registration and blue-grey/grey-concrete palette across ALL frames. Painted high detail miniature RTS asset. Exactly the SAME factory architecture, roof vents, chevron, open garage and 2:1 isometric rectangular foundation from reference. Foundation occupies 70% width of each cell; center x=50%, lowest tip y=88%, roof y=35%, padding above for smoke.
Stages: 1 intact factory; 2 bullet scars and a small smoke leak, still standing; 3 cracked walls, scorch marks, denser smoke, standing; 4 orange interior flash at right wall, roof still intact; 5 roof buckles inward with fractured concrete and small sparks; 6 one side wall collapses inward as roof tilts, localized dust; 7 roof drops halfway, steel beams bend, dust expands; 8 full structural collapse leaving bent beams, dust maximum but does not fill cell; 9 dust clears to rubble with broken dark-blue roof pieces and one recognizable garage pillar; 10 only a very small fire and smoke over collapsed roof debris; 11 cooling charred rubble, fading smoke; 12 stable cold wreck with recognizable blue roof slabs, twisted steel columns and cracked concrete foundation, no flame. Debris remains within foundation plus tiny rim. No giant cinematic fireball obscuring structure. No people, no gore. Never transform back to intact, no rotating building, no shrunken whole-building icon. End is a truly collapsed low-profile ruin, not merely dark recoloring.
prompts.tank:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production animation sprite sheet. Reference is ONLY the blue-marked olive battle tank in top row SECOND cell, the southeast-facing three-quarter view. Exactly 12 frames in a 4-column 3-row equal grid, landscape1536x1024, transparent background. No background gradients or scenery or captions or borders. Fixed orthographic camera at 30 degree elevation, SAME tank same orientation and scale all frames. Match reference detailed worn olive armour, cyan chevron, angular turret, long gun, 6 road wheels each side, soft upper left light. Track contact footprint and center fixed exactly; tank hull spans 65% of each cell and muzzle aims lower-right. Leave safe space ahead of muzzle and behind tracks.
ONE firing cycle: 1 tank aims gun, idle; 2 holds aim; 3 compact brilliant yellow-white muzzle flash with orange periphery, BARREL recoils toward turret by 8% length, turret and hull remain fixed; 4 recoil peak and cone of dust, compact smoke at muzzle; 5 flash gone, recoil returning halfway, dust dissipates; 6 gun nearly returns, fine grey smoke; 7 fully returned gun, smoke thinning; 8 settled; 9 settled with faint barrel smoke; 10 idle; 11 idle; 12 idle identical to frame1. NO firing in frames10-12. NO moving tracks or changing hull position. Keep ground shadow minimal. No huge fireball covering tank, no bending barrel, no extra weapons, no text. Thick armoured geometry consistent and crisp in every frame.
prompts.repair:
Use case: stylized-concept. Sprite animation for miniature RTS, 12 frames in EXACT 4 columns x 3 rows equally sized, landscape1536x1024, transparent background. Reference: ONE blue-vest yellow-hardhat engineer at top left, exact same olive uniform, blue harness/vest, yellow hardhat with ear protectors, tool pouches, black boots, yellow toolbox. Fixed southeast-facing orthographic 30 degree elevated camera and upper-left light. Same identity, scale and ground pivot all frames, feet midpoint at x=42%,y=86% each cell, helmet y=18% when standing.
Show a maintenance/repair cycle: 1 standing with toolbox; 2 sets toolbox down to right; 3 crouches and takes a tool; 4 kneels on right knee facing lower-right; 5 leans forward with small handheld powered repair tool; 6 uses tool, small restrained orange sparks 15 pixels long from tip; 7 works and adjusts tool with both hands; 8 works with small orange sparks; 9 tool stops and inspect repair; 10 packs tool away; 11 stands and picks toolbox; 12 same standing pose as frame1. No large building or vehicle; repair point just beyond hands, engineer is isolated. Do not add another person. Solid anatomy and plausible knee bend. No text, no borders, no floor planes, no backdrop, no vignette, no glow except tiny tool sparks. Preserve realistic handpainted worn materials and tactical gear of reference. Enough padding to prevent any crop, all props stay inside own cell.
prompts.fall:
Use case: stylized-concept. 12 frame NON-GRAPHIC single soldier fall animation for an RTS. Reference is the one blue-armband rifleman in top left, exact matching olive kit, helmet, vest, pouches, knee pads, rifle and black boots. Output1536x1024 landscape, strict4 columns x3 rows equal cells in reading order, TRANSPARENT background, no text, no borders or ground scenery. Same high-detail painted miniature rendering, soft upper-left light, fixed southeast-facing orthographic elevated30degree camera. Camera and scale never move. Soldier center x=45%, ground line y=84%, standing head y=18%. Plenty of width for fallen figure.
Sequence: 1 standing rifle ready; 2 mild impact stagger leaning back, NO blood; 3 knees buckle; 4 drops to right knee; 5 torso tips sideways, left hand reaching toward ground; 6 left hand touches ground, hips descend; 7 rolls onto side, rifle beside hands; 8 settles fully on left side, both legs on ground; 9 settles still; 10 same settled still pose; 11 identical still pose; 12 identical still pose. Keep helmet on, gear attached, anatomy intact, natural gravity. Non-graphic, no wounds, blood, gore or dismemberment. A readable game death transition, not an acrobatic roll. The figure stays inside cell, grounded, no floating; rifle does not disappear. Do NOT get back up in last frames.
